provenance.sourceAccessMethod: README and voice guide read first; complete assigned index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md read locally. Lisbon English/data read for structure only. No other run folder read, network research, contact, registration, application or quote submission during authoring.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Original source ledger discloses opaque managed-browser fallback routes whose clean/empty session state was not established. Later fresh-context verification of selected platform sources does not cure this historical exception. Do not describe the whole research process as credential-free or fully clean-session. KPDN current regulation text was not retrieved; MBSA home-premises permission and Shopee exact food commission table remain unread/unconfirmed.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: Assigned historical review reports 85 exact arithmetic assertions passed plus six kitchen sensitivities, no material arithmetic defect, and a bounded raw-anchor claim audit. Its stale Shopee-support summary wording was corrected in the source final delta. Standard Shopee payment/support/waiver evidence is primary-verified in the ledger; exact sambal commission and special methods remain unknown. This authoring is not a fresh external verification or approval.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: Original independent check records sampled desktop/mobile observations and later source-HTML layout checks at 1440x1000 and 390x844. No build, render or visual certification of the new locale guides was performed.

datePolicy: All cited sources have original access date November 7, 2026 expressly recorded in the assigned source ledger. No external re-access during authoring. Publication/effective dates differ from access dates; early-2027 rates, laws, waivers and approvals are not guaranteed. Copy editing is not research refresh.

planningAssumptions.profile: Aisyah, 38, Shah Alam; assumes Malaysian citizen/permanent-resident sole-proprietor eligibility, not individually confirmed.
planningAssumptions.deliveryPolicy: Buyer pays actual postage separately; no verified route quote or nationwide service. Model assumes postage exactly offset, with shipping-base payment fees and adjustments reconciled separately.

marketplaceCushions.status: Chosen allowances, not published totals, fee range or ceiling; one jar/order, no waivers or optional paid programmes assumed.

sharedKitchenSensitivity.status: Sensitivity, not a rental quote; actual cost must fit the budget.

planningAssumptions.calendarQualification: Conditional January–June 2027 ramp, not demand forecast or cumulative cash balance; every financial row uses the same 40:60 illustration despite direct-first launch actions. January all-direct alternative is RM540 revenue / -RM171 surplus. Shift calendar if gates fail; bundles require fresh order/packing calculations.
planningAssumptions.decisionGate: Resolve exact MBSA premises permission and product/process/storage/shelf-life safety before producing for sale. Use an appropriately approved shared kitchen only if actual cost fits; otherwise delay, not a commercial lease. Confirm glass-compatible acceptance, actual platform deductions and delivery economics before expanding.
planningAssumptions.assumptionStatus: Except identified published tariffs, prices, yields, costs, sales mix, volume ramp and postage are planning assumptions, not quotes or market-tested demand. Surplus already deducts owner labour, but excludes tax, capital recovery and extra rent.

uncertainties: MBSA address-specific permission, applicable licence/planning route, property restrictions, fees, inspections and turnaround; no individual approval secured.

Actual recipe/texture classification, allergens and supplier composition, container dimensions, validated process, shelf life and chilled-chain needs. Nutrition/date marking likely for sauce classification; 200g is not an exemption.
KPDN current e-commerce regulation body unavailable; listing advice is prudent preparation, not exhaustive verified law.
Exact Shopee sambal category commission and special payment/programme rates remain unconfirmed; standard payment/support and conditional eligibility are supported by original primary reads.
TikTok Pantry Food classification is assumed; early-2027 fees, BXP base, waiver continuation and individual eligibility require confirmation.
No actual postcode/packed-weight/glass-compatible courier quote or fragile cover; SPX newer public glass exclusion stands unless an applicable contract explicitly permits otherwise.

Halal kitchen eligibility, owner-as-worker treatment, invoice and extra compliance costs unknown; RM220 is conditional base arithmetic, not all-inclusive approval cost. Original legal Gazette was not a complete consolidated amendment-history review.
Historical clean-session compliance not fully demonstrated; later clean reads do not erase disclosed opaque fallback routes. No new external verification during localization.
